// REQ: LANG-2821 LANG-2822 LANG-2823 LANG-2824
#include "inkey.ch"
/* Customer listing */
FUNCTION Main()
   LOCAL nCount := 0, cName := "world"
   USE customer INDEX custname
   DO WHILE .NOT. EOF()
      IF customer->balance > 0 .AND. .T.
         QOut("Hello, " + Trim(customer->name) + "!")
         nCount++
      ENDIF
      SKIP
   ENDDO
   RETURN nCount
